climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: An irrigated region of river flats along the Murray River in South Australia, and the only region in the Lower Murray zone. It has about 53,900 acres of vines. Shiraz is the most planted grape, followed by Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon.
